name: Safe
description: you are protected from abuse and avoidable harm.

name: Effective
description: your care, treatment and support achieves good outcomes, helps you to maintain quality of life and is based on the best available evidence.

name: Caring
description: staff involve and treat you with compassion, kindness, dignity and respect.

name: Responsive
description: services are organised so that they meet your needs.

name: Well-led
description: the leadership, management and governance of the organisation make sure it's providing high-quality care that's based around your individual needs, that it encourages learning and innovation, and that it promotes an open and fair culture.
